text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Fenomeno completed all the training scheduled for today.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much for your guidance today as well, sir!
Amidst the fatigue, I feel a tangible sense of progress!
With that, excuse me—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
May I begin my independent training
from here on out?!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I have no complaints
about the training menu the Boss devised.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
However, by adding some extra training to that,
I will tackle a 120% regimen every single day.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
The accumulation of discipline will eventually yield great results
and lead to a brighter future.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"I want to prove that
with my own body, sir!"
choice_data_list: Got it, you should give it a try.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I knew you would say that,
Boss!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Now that I have received the Boss's approval, I will execute it with all my might!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Fenomeno enthusiastically worked up
yet another sweat.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Wh-Why is that, sir?
May I inquire as to the reason?
choice_data_list: Because a future where you force yourself isn't a good one.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Ngh! You are right, Boss.
This officer was shortsighted...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I shall wrap things up here for today.
Instead, I will rest well and prepare for tomorrow, sir!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After making a level-headed judgment,
Fenomeno headed back to the dorms.
